interpretation.changeDescription: Introduced a generic Builder pattern for ChatOptions and its subclasses by parameterizing the Builder interface (e.g., Builder<B extends Builder<B>>). Added a mutate() method to the ChatOptions interface to allow cloning options into a builder for modification, and implemented this in DefaultChatOptions and DefaultToolCallingChatOptions. Added a combineWith() method to support merging configuration options across builders. Refactored constructors and builders to support this fluent, type-safe API, and introduced an AbstractChatOptionsTests base class for testing these new patterns.
interpretation.changeMotivation: The previous implementation lacked a consistent, type-safe, and fluent way to modify existing chat options (the 'copy' pattern was limited and did not support easy chainable modification). By using a self-referential generic builder (B extends Builder<B>), the framework now allows chaining specific builder methods while ensuring the correct concrete type is returned. The addition of mutate() provides a clean mechanism to create a 'mutable' version of an existing immutable configuration, improving usability for request-specific configuration overrides and reducing boilerplate code for model developers.
